host.description: Fully qualified domain name for ARSnova, like 'arsnova.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

admin_email.title: Administrator account
admin_email.description: E-mail address of a registered ARSnova user that should be granted administrator rights. Leave empty to keep everyone a regular user.

allow_registration.title: Allow self-registration
allow_registration.description: Allow anyone to create a new account from the login page. Disable to keep strangers from signing up; existing and AD/LDAP logins keep working.

smtp_host.title: Manual SMTP relay host
smtp_host.description: Fallback plain SMTP relay (port 25, no authentication) used only when no cluster smarthost is configured. Leave empty to rely on the cluster smarthost.

smtp_from.title: Mail sender address
smtp_from.description: Sender address for ARSnova e-mails. Defaults to arsnova@<domain>.

ldap_enabled.title: Enable AD/LDAP login
ldap_enabled.description: Allow login with Active Directory / LDAP accounts.

ldap_url.title: LDAP URL
ldap_url.description: LDAPS URL of the directory server, e.g. ldaps://ad.example.org:636

ldap_bind_dn.title: Bind DN
ldap_bind_dn.description: Service account used to search the directory, e.g. ldapservice@ad.example.org

ldap_group.title: Access group DN
ldap_group.description: Distinguished name of the group whose members may log in. Empty means any directory user.

ldap_user_attribute.title: Login attribute
ldap_user_attribute.description: Attribute matched against the entered user name. Defaults to sAMAccountName (Active Directory).

ldap_title.title: Provider label
ldap_title.description: Label shown on the login page for this provider. Defaults to 'AD'.
